name: dobe_idle_key
desc: Pixel art game sprite of a huge muscular paint monster shaped like a Doberman: tall pointed ears, long narrow muzzle, small head on a very thick neck, massive broad shoulders and chest, big arms with clenched fists, defined abs, the lower body melts into a wide puddle of glossy pink paint goo. Glossy hot pink with flowing yellow marble streaks, drool dripping from the mouth, sly smug smirk with narrowed yellow eyes. Three-quarter view facing left, standing idle pose. Same pixel art style, size and palette as the reference crocodile sprite: dark outline, glossy highlights, drips.
